name: Young Lacewing Dragon
biography: A young lacewing dragon, its silk breath already strong enough to cocoon whole hunting parties. Habitat: Forest & Jungle.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The dragon can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

features.name: Stitching Prey
features.description: Some of the dragon's actions cause a hit creature to be threaded. A threaded creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet. A creature stops being threaded when it or a creature within 5 feet of it cuts the threads by hitting them (AC 5) with an attack that deals Slashing damage.

features.name: Web Walker
features.description: The dragon ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing, and it knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: The dragon makes one Bite attack and two Needleclaw attacks.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

features.name: Needleclaw
features.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target is threaded (see Stitching Prey trait).

features.name: Silk Breath (Recharge 5-6)
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 15 Dexterity, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 28 (8d6) Poison damage, and the target is threaded (see Stitching Prey trait). While threaded in this way, the target is Restrained. Success: Half damage only.

features.name: Thread Pull
features.description: Saving Throw: DC 15 Strength, one threaded creature within 60 feet. Failure: The target is moved up to 30 feet in a direction of the dragon's choice and knocked Prone. Success: The target is knocked Prone only.
